create_onetwo_api: create a OneTwoAPI backend instance connected to a model server endpoint for text generation
configure_llm_defaults: configure LLM generation defaults like temperature, max_tokens, stop sequences, top_p, and top_k on the OneTwoAPI backend
generate_text_from_prompt: generate text from a prompt string using the OneTwoAPI backend with configurable generation parameters
tokenize_content: tokenize a text string into a list of integer token IDs via the OneTwoAPI backend
count_tokens_in_content: count the number of tokens in a text string using the OneTwoAPI backend
